203073e3b93817a41fae4383b1040ff919160864.summary: A VirusTotal detection page for a single file, flagged as malicious by 28 of 45 security vendors. Vendor detection labels include Zbot, Gspy, Virut and Kryptik variants, and the packer label 'peexe armadillo' is shown. The file is listed as 128.00 KB and was last analysed '13 years ago' relative to the page capture. The page names no actors, sectors or countries and describes no techniques.

dates.what: Last analysis of the file, shown relative to when the page was captured

figures.q: 28/45 security vendors flagged this file as malicious

20397b96d8cb8c1ee915292f80346562294bddc0.summary: This is a webinar listing from Kaspersky, announcing a talk on the Fin7 group. It says Fin7 continued after the 2018 arrests of its leaders, extended its operations to more groups, and still aims to steal financial assets. The page contains no technical findings of its own, and most of it is channel and company boilerplate, so it is not a threat report.

audit_history.note: summary: The text says only "Europol and the DoJ" announced the arrests. It never says "US", so "US DoJ" adds detail the text doesn't give.

audit.note: summary: The summary drops the text's hedges and misstates the content. The text says that after the 2018 arrests it was believed the group would cease activity
